required_inputs: failed verifier report; packet manifest; problem codes; immutable packet bytes
decision_outputs: preserve failure; rerun independent verifier; publish problem-code bulletin
escalation_condition: problem code is unknown; packet bytes cannot be reproduced; two verifier paths disagree
public_boundary_sentence: A failed packet review records verifier findings and preservation steps only.
retention_action: preserve packet bytes, verifier stdout or JSON, manifest digest, and reviewer decision log
non_claims: not outcome certification; not proof of intent or fraud; not legal advice

required_inputs: publication contract; expected URL or channel id; observation window; witness notes
decision_outputs: missingness record; bounded public status; correction or escalation request
escalation_condition: deadline affects a rights-bearing public instruction or statutory notice
public_boundary_sentence: A missingness review records that an expected artifact was not found by the stated deadline.
retention_action: preserve observation times, surface ids, request metadata, and non-private witness notes
non_claims: not proof of suppression; not proof of intent or fraud; not outcome certification

retention_action: preserve digests, timestamps, channel ids, and bounded route labels; redact private browsing data
non_claims: not proof of targeting; not proof of intent or fraud; not outcome certification

retention_action: preserve old and new keysets, signed event, witness acknowledgements, and policy-profile digest
non_claims: not proof of compromise impact; not outcome certification; not legal advice

public_boundary_sentence: A supporting-technology review records the outage and recovery evidence for named non-voting systems.

non_claims: not voting-system certification; not proof of changed votes; not outcome certification; not legal advice

required_inputs: source lock row; citation role; review_by value; replacement or pinning note

non_claims: not proof the source is wrong; not outcome certification; not legal advice
